name: IDVR-Compositing
definition: A step that assigns a sparseness value to each object on a per-ray basis to modify color and opacity values before global compositing. Sparseness defines how much screen estate an object takes up.
summary: IDVR-Compositing is a view-dependent strategy that modulates sample opacity based on object importance to make less significant objects transparent, differing from standard compositing by using a pre-compositing modulation step.
